prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a four-panel elegant night-out fashion editorial of a generic adult woman with blonde wavy center-parted hair and natural dewy makeup wearing an opaque ebony-black satin slip dress with thin spaghetti straps and a flattering neckline. Panel one is frontal with hands interlocked at waist; panel two is frontal tilted while adjusting hair and looking away; panel three is left side profile with one hand resting at lower back or hip; panel four is an over-the-shoulder rear view looking back to reveal the dress back design. Set the series in a rustic-chic upscale restaurant with exposed stone brick, white linen tables, crystal glasses, cutlery and cylindrical candle protectors. Use warm candlelight, black, warm gold, white and wood tones, shallow depth of field and sophisticated high-fashion realism. Do not reproduce any public-figure likeness.
